_what: the corpus-level recipe: knobs that apply to the cross-night combine and to nothing else. Per-set recipes live in datasets/<session>/<set>/recipe.json; this file holds only what a set cannot carry. A constant that shapes a product lives HERE, visible and tracked, never as a script default.

portion_rule.rule: per member, onset = the smallest station dx where FWHM(+dx) - FWHM(-dx) > bar_px and stays above outward; x_c = onset - half_width_px; the entry-side columns beyond W/2 + x_c are removed (Siril crop of a copy); a member with no station over the bar is untouched
portion_rule.scope: the corpus combine only (run_corpus_combine.sh --portion-rule); the per-set finals are not run through it until measured there
